notes.title: Simple Stock Simulator Now Available
notes.notes:
Hello There Poetical Trader,

Simple Stock Trading Simulator is now available to add to your Steam Library. 
It has been a long 3 Month Delay, but we are finally here and I am so excited to finally be able to release my game for you all. 
Good luck in your pursuits in becoming a Simple Stock Trading Pro and take what you have learned in this game to the actual markets or other games similar in nature. Also, most importantly, have FUN!

notes.title: Game Delay
notes.notes: Hello Potential Trader, I regret to inform you that the anticipated release of the Simple Stock Trading Simulator is experiencing a slight delay. Unforeseen events have necessitated an extension of the release timeline. Rest assured, I am diligently addressing the challenges to expedite the launch process, and I appreciate your understanding during this period. I anticipate bringing the game to you at the earliest possible date. Thank you for your patience and continued support.
